name: GSAP Runtime Adapter
summary: Build seek-safe GSAP timelines, tweens, easing and stagger patterns for HyperFrames compositions.
problem: GSAP animations must be expressed as deterministic timelines so preview and frame rendering agree at arbitrary timestamps.
coreOutcomes: Author paused timelines and time-positioned tweens
Apply easing, stagger and timeline composition patterns
Keep animation effects compatible with HyperFrames seeking
requirements: GSAP available to the composition runtime
boundaries: Covers GSAP implementation patterns, not full scene design
Do not use wall-clock animation loops for rendered motion
